review_scope: Recheck of T14 after a85434e; source is not modified.

caveats: Retrospective branch (cex_*, whaleflow_*, large_cex_*) uses current T07 labels: not point-in-time evidence.

PIT branch (pit_cex_*, whaleflow_pit_*, pit_large_*) uses C_D = approved public-history registry with public_available_at, effective_from < D and effective_to > D or null. This is public-information PIT, not the research-knowledge policy of T12 v2.
Days without any approved label are NaN, not zero; days with labels and no transfers are 0.
Known-CEX coverage is the observed share of the thresholded USDT network, not CEX recall; unknown addresses may be exchange wallets.
Network covers netted USDT transfers >= 500000 only, not all Ethereum flows.
spread_cs_proxy is a Corwin-Schultz high-low proxy, not a quoted spread; T06 has trades only.
Cohort = unidentified high-activity addresses (T12 v2); no individual ownership inference.

WhaleFlow PIT keeps v2 membership/rank. On the flow boundary a node in W and C_D is treated as CEX (core = W minus C_D acts as cohort side); overlap counts and edge volume are reported, not hidden. This is NOT a new top-50 cohort and the choice of scope belongs to the team.
CEX->CEX volume is reported as internal and is excluded from external NetFlow; no DEX/bridge/market maker/issuer treasury is merged into CEX.
